title: The Death of Saul

questions.question: Where did the battle take place where Saul died?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 31:1 (ESV): “...and the men of Israel fled before the Philistines and fell slain on Mount Gilboa.”

questions.question: Which sons of Saul died in the battle?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 31:2 (ESV): “...The Philistines killed Jonathan and Abinadab and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.”

questions.question: How was Saul wounded?
options: Archers found him and wounded him badly
questions.correctAnswer: Archers found him and wounded him badly
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 31:3 (ESV): “...The archers found him, and he was badly wounded by the archers.”

questions.question: How did Saul die?
options: He fell on his own sword
questions.correctAnswer: He fell on his own sword
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 31:4 (ESV): “Therefore Saul took his own sword and fell upon it.”

questions.question: What did the men of Jabesh-gilead do?
options: They took the bodies of Saul and his sons and burned them, then buried the bones
questions.correctAnswer: They took the bodies of Saul and his sons and burned them, then buried the bones
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 31:11-13 (ESV): “...took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons... and burned them there. And they took their bones and buried them...”

questions.question: What did Saul ask his armor-bearer to do?
options: Draw his sword and thrust him through
questions.correctAnswer: Draw his sword and thrust him through
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 31:4 (ESV): "Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, 'Draw your sword and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through and mistreat me.'"

questions.question: Why did the armor-bearer refuse to kill Saul?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 31:4 (ESV): "But his armor-bearer would not, for he was terrified."

questions.question: What did the armor-bearer do when he saw Saul was dead?
options: He also fell upon his sword and died
questions.correctAnswer: He also fell upon his sword and died
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 31:5 (ESV): "And when his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell upon his sword and died with him."

questions.question: What did the Philistines do with Saul's armor?
options: Put it in the temple of Ashtaroth
questions.correctAnswer: Put it in the temple of Ashtaroth
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 31:10 (ESV): "They put his armor in the temple of Ashtaroth..."

questions.question: Where did the Philistines fasten Saul's body?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 31:10 (ESV): "...and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth-shan."

questions.question: Who fled when they saw the army defeated?
options: The men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley
questions.correctAnswer: The men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 31:7 (ESV): "And when the men of Israel... saw that the men of Israel had fled... they abandoned their cities and fled..."

questions.question: How long did the men of Jabesh-gilead fast after burying the bones?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 31:13 (ESV): "...buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh and fasted seven days."

questions.question: Who went to retrieve the bodies?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 31:12 (ESV): "All the valiant men arose and went all night and took the body of Saul..."

questions.question: What did the Philistines do on the next day?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 31:8 (ESV): "The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul..."

questions.question: What message was sent throughout the land of the Philistines?
options: Good news in the house of their idols and to the people
questions.correctAnswer: Good news in the house of their idols and to the people
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 31:9 (ESV): "...and sent messengers... to carry the good news in the house of their idols and to the people."

key_verse_text: Thus Saul died, and his three sons, and his armor-bearer, and all his men, on the same day together. (ESV)
